title: Split auth hooks and rename iterable streams; align retry schemas across SDKs
author: Priya Nair
description: This PR refactors SDK streaming ergonomics by splitting authentication lifecycle hooks from streaming primitives, renaming iterable types for clearer ergonomics, and standardizing retry schema names across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. Motivation: teams reported confusion when auth warmup and token rotation logic lived on stream objects (caused surprising reauths during short-lived streams) and inconsistent names across SDKs made cross-team migrations error-prone. Changes include: 1) Introduce AuthProvider and AuthWarmup hooks (optional) that are registered on the client factory so streaming objects no longer mutate credential state. 2) Rename public pull/async iterable types: Python async_iter -> StreamReader, TS PullStream -> StreamReader, Go PullIterator -> StreamReaderIterator for clearer intent and parity. 3) Split retry configuration into retry_presets (user-facing friendly presets) and retry_profiles (runtime-configured profiles) and wire them into the SDK config vignette. 4) Minor runtime opt: reduce token handshake frequency for rapid reconnects by caching last-successful-sig per-session. 5) Bump SDK versions: py->3.2.0, ts->2.7.0, go->v1.6.4. Migration notes included in release_notes. See linked Linear tickets for benchmarks and adoption plan. Checklist: - [x] Implement AuthProvider + warmup hook - [x] Rename iterable types and update all internal references - [x] Migrate retry names and docs - [x] Add compatibility shims for one release cycle - [x] Run integration test matrix (py/ts/go) - [x] Update changelogs and examples
commit_summary: feat(auth): introduce AuthProvider and warmup hook
refactor(streams): rename async_iter/PullStream/PullIterator to StreamReader variants
feat(retries): add retry_presets and retry_profiles separation
chore(release): bump sdk versions (py 3.2.0, ts 2.7.0, go v1.6.4)
docs: add migration guide and examples

Jonah Li: Found a subtle race during token warmup in the TS client on reconnect; suggested ensuring warmup runs under client-level lock — requested changes
Priya Nair: Moved warmup to client factory lock and added unit test to validate no concurrent warmups — reply
Marisol Gomez: Please add a short perf note on handshake caching; verify it does not mask auth failures — comment
Priya Nair: Added perf microbench results to docs and retained fallback path for failed cache verification — reply
Marisol Gomez: Approving after the added tests and docs — approved
release_notes: SDKs: Introduce AuthProvider and AuthWarmup hooks; rename stream iterables to StreamReader variants for clearer cross-language parity; separate retry_presets (user-facing) from retry_profiles (runtime); compatibility aliases provided for one release; SDK versions bumped: Python 3.2.0, TypeScript 2.7.0, Go v1.6.4. See docs/sdk-migration/retry-profiles.md and examples/getting-started/streaming-migration.md for migration steps.
